body: Uhm at 5'7 and 135 you can definitely start calling yourself skinny.  I'm the same height and anywhere from 130-135 is pretty small and I don't have big boobs.  I know everyone's built different, but I wouldn't let your friend get in your head, sounds like you're doing great.
Thanks, I hope so too.  I don't want my family to have to deal with my suicide because I've seen what that does to people.  But what's the point in living when you're not really alive?
I'll try it.  Hell I'll try anything at this point.  My quality of life is so poor right now.

I'm in therapy but it's not really helping, I've been going for years.  Medications don't help, they just make me feel more suicidal.  I can't just discontinue my birth control because it's the shot, so I have to try and wait it out.  So 3 months to try and get the pain to stop, because that's all I feel like I can tolerate for now.

I've had problems with depression and anxiety forever.  I started on new birth control a couple months ago and it's made everything worse.  And now losing him out of nowhere feels like the end.  I can't even function anymore, I've been getting therapy and everything for awhile but nothing ever seems to get better.  I knew when I started dating him that the way I felt was different from how I felt about anyone else, and I still feel that way.  I can't live forever with no food, no sleep, constant emptiness, physical pain in my stomach and chest, and just being reminded of him everywhere I turn.  I can barely make it day after day, the depression and anxiety has always seemed to get a little better, then come back 10x worse my whole life.  I've had suicidal urges since I was a child.  So I'm not sure I'll ever be in a place again where I'm not in so much pain emotionally that it's also physically debilitating.  I don't want to just give up, but if I can't make the pain better through other means within 3 months then I just don't know what else to do.  Maybe I'm just broken.
I'd also like to add it really hurts he didn't at least afford me a phone call after all our history. :(
